name: Elderforest
source:
Elderforest will let you explore the protagonist's life, a masochistic prince who is arranged to marry a princess elf to take over the throne, but soon he finds an intricate web of lies and secrets that pushes him to investigate the many mysteries that lie in the castle.
You will soon learn magic, which you can use wisely (or not) to get what you want. Either to fulfill your masochistic desires or to challenge those who defy you.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Elderforest]Patreon[/url]]
